name: Printify
description: Printify print-on-demand: shops, products, the blueprint catalog with print providers, variants and shipping, the image library, orders and webhooks. Printify REST API v1 with a personal access token.
instructions:
## Printify
This connector talks to the Printify REST API v1 (`https://api.printify.com/v1`). Printify prints and ships products on demand; the merchant designs a product in Printify and Printify publishes it to a sales channel such as Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom API store.

## Setup
1. In Printify open **My Profile → Connections** and click **Generate** under Personal Access Tokens.
2. Pick the access scopes. For everything this connector does: `shops.read`, `catalog.read`, `print_providers.read`, `products.read`, `products.write`, `orders.read`, `orders.write`, `uploads.read`, `uploads.write`, `webhooks.read`. A read-only setup only needs the `*.read` scopes.
3. Copy the token (it is shown once) into `PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN`. Tokens expire after one year; generate a new one then.

The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Printify also requires a `User-Agent` header on every request; the connector sends one.

## Start here
Call `printify_list_shops` first. Every product, order and webhook belongs to a shop, and the shop `id` (a number) is the `shop_id` of all shop tools. The `sales_channel` field tells where the shop publishes (for example `etsy`, `shopify`, `custom_integration`, or `disconnected`).

## Printify and Etsy
An Etsy shop connected to Printify appears in `printify_list_shops` with `sales_channel` `etsy`. Products are created and edited in Printify; `printify_publish_product` pushes them to the Etsy listing (title, description, images, variants, tags and, for Etsy, the shipping profile). Etsy orders for Printify products arrive automatically and show up in `printify_list_orders`; there is no need to create them with `printify_create_order`. Use the Etsy connector for listing statistics, reviews and buyer messages, and this one for production, costs and fulfillment. Edit a published product in Printify and publish again rather than editing the Etsy listing directly, or the two drift apart.

## Building a product
1. `printify_list_blueprints` to find the base product (a blueprint, for example a t-shirt model).
2. `printify_list_blueprint_print_providers` for who can print it, then `printify_list_variants` for sizes, colours and print area placeholders, and `printify_get_shipping` for shipping costs.
3. `printify_upload_image` with a public image URL; keep the returned image `id`.
4. `printify_create_product` with blueprint, print provider, variants (price in cents) and print areas referencing the image id.
5. `printify_publish_product` to send it to the sales channel.

## Ids, money and pagination
- Shop ids and catalog ids (blueprint, print provider, variant) are integers; product, order, upload and webhook ids are 24-character hex strings.
- Prices and costs are integers in cents of the shop currency (`2499` = 24.99).
- Lists of products, orders and uploads are paged: `page` starts at 1; `limit` is at most 50 for products, 10 for orders and 100 for uploads. The answer carries `current_page`, `last_page` and `total`.

## Rate limits
600 requests per minute per account, and 100 per minute for catalog endpoints. Publishing is limited to 200 calls per 30 minutes. Printify asks that errors stay below 5% of all requests, so look ids up before guessing them.

## Pitfalls
- `printify_send_order_to_production` charges the merchant's Printify balance or card. `printify_cancel_order` only works while the order is `on-hold` or `payment-not-received`.
- `printify_publish_product` does nothing visible on a shop with no sales channel; on a custom API store it only fires the publish event.
- Variants that are out of stock are hidden from `printify_list_variants` unless `show_out_of_stock` is 1.

PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN.label: Personal access token
PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN.help: Printify → My Profile → Connections → Personal Access Tokens → Generate. Choose the access scopes, then copy the token; it is shown only once and is valid for one year.
PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: A Printify token is a long string starting with eyJ, made of three parts separated by dots.

verifyHints.401: Printify refused the token. Tokens expire after one year and are shown only once: generate a new one under My Profile → Connections.
verifyHints.403: The token lacks an access scope. Generate a token that includes at least shops.read, then the scopes for the tools you use.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Printify allows 600 requests per minute per account (100 for the catalog). Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: printify_list_shops
tools.description: List the shops in the Printify account with their id, title and sales channel (etsy, shopify, custom_integration, disconnected). Call this first: the shop id is needed by every product, order and webhook tool.

tools.name: printify_list_blueprints
tools.description: List every blueprint in the Printify catalog: the base products (t-shirts, mugs, posters...) with id, title, brand, model and images. Use it to find the blueprint_id before choosing a print provider.

tools.name: printify_get_blueprint
tools.description: Get one catalog blueprint by id: title, description, brand, model and product images. Use it to read the details of a base product found with printify_list_blueprints.

tools.name: printify_list_blueprint_print_providers
tools.description: List the print providers that can produce a blueprint, with their id, name and decoration methods (dtg, embroidery...). Pick one to read its variants, shipping and costs.

tools.name: printify_list_variants
tools.description: List the variants (size, colour) of a blueprint at one print provider, with variant ids and the print area placeholders and their dimensions. Variant ids are needed to create products and orders.

show_out_of_stock.description: 1 to include variants that are out of stock, 0 or omitted for in-stock variants only.

tools.name: printify_get_shipping
tools.description: Get the shipping profiles of a blueprint at one print provider: handling time and first-item and additional-item costs in cents per variant and country. Use it to price products and estimate delivery.

tools.name: printify_list_print_providers
tools.description: List all Printify print providers with their id, title and location. Use it to compare providers or find one in a given country.

tools.name: printify_get_print_provider
tools.description: Get one print provider by id: name, location and the blueprints it produces. Use it to see what else a provider can print.

tools.name: printify_list_products
tools.description: List the products of a shop, newest first, with title, variants and prices, images, print areas, visibility and the sales channel listing in `external`. Paged: up to 50 per page.

tools.name: printify_get_product
tools.description: Get one product of a shop with all details: variants with price, cost and SKU, print areas and images, mockups, tags, publishing state and the linked sales channel listing.

product_id.description: Product id (24 hex characters) from printify_list_products.

tools.name: printify_create_product
tools.description: Create a product in a shop from a blueprint and print provider: title, description, variants with prices in cents and print areas placing uploaded images. Returns the new product. It is not published until printify_publish_product.

variants.description: Variants to offer: [{"id": 17390, "price": 2499, "is_enabled": true}]. Ids from printify_list_variants, price in cents.

tags.description: Tags passed to the sales channel listing.

safety_information.description: GPSR safety information shown to EU buyers (manufacturer, product info, warnings, care).

tools.name: printify_update_product
tools.description: Update a product: title, description, tags, variant prices and enabled flags, or print areas. Only the fields passed are changed. Publish again afterwards to push the change to the sales channel.

tags.description: New tag list (replaces the old one).

variants.description: Variants with id, price in cents and is_enabled.

print_areas.description: Replacement print areas, same shape as in printify_create_product.

tools.name: printify_delete_product
tools.description: Delete a product from a Printify shop. This cannot be undone. A listing already published to the sales channel is not removed by Printify; check it there.

tools.name: printify_publish_product
tools.description: Publish a product to the shop's sales channel (for example the Etsy listing). Each flag says which parts to push; omitted flags count as true. Limited to 200 calls per 30 minutes.

shipping_template.description: Push the shipping profile (Etsy and Amazon only).

tools.name: printify_list_uploads
tools.description: List the images in the account's media library with id, file name, size, dimensions and preview URL. Paged: up to 100 per page. Image ids are used in product print areas.

tools.name: printify_get_upload
tools.description: Get one uploaded image by id: file name, dimensions, size, MIME type, preview URL and upload time. Use it to check an image before placing it on a product.

image_id.description: Image id from printify_list_uploads or printify_upload_image.

tools.name: printify_upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image to the media library from a public URL (preferred) or base64 contents. Returns the image id to use in print areas. Printify downloads the URL itself, so it must be reachable from the internet.

file_name.description: File name with extension, e.g. design.png.

url.description: Public URL of the image. Use this or contents.

contents.description: Base64-encoded image contents, for small files only (under 5 MB). Use this or url.

tools.name: printify_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders of a shop, newest first, with status, line items and costs, shipping address, shipments and tracking. Filter by status or SKU. Paged: at most 10 per page.

sku.description: Only orders that contain a product with this SKU.

tools.name: printify_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with status, line items with production cost and shipping cost in cents, the address, shipments with carrier and tracking number, and print provider details.

order_id.description: Order id (24 hex characters) from printify_list_orders.

tools.name: printify_calculate_shipping
tools.description: Calculate the shipping cost of a would-be order for an address without creating it. Returns the cost in cents for standard, priority, express and economy shipping where available.

address_to.description: Destination: first_name, last_name, email, phone, country (ISO 2-letter), region, address1, address2, city, zip.

tools.name: printify_create_order
tools.description: Create an order in a shop for existing products (product_id + variant_id), SKUs, or catalog items with print areas. It is placed on hold until printify_send_order_to_production; orders from Etsy or Shopify arrive by themselves.

send_shipping_notification.description: Let Printify e-mail the customer when the order ships.

address_to.description: Recipient: first_name, last_name, email, phone, country (ISO 2-letter), region, address1, address2, city, zip.

tools.name: printify_send_order_to_production
tools.description: Send an on-hold order to production. Printify charges the order to the merchant's balance or card and passes it to the print provider; it can no longer be edited.

tools.name: printify_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order. Only accepted while its status is on-hold or payment-not-received; orders already in production cannot be canceled through the API.

tools.name: printify_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks installed on a shop with id, topic (order:created, product:publish:started...) and target URL. Use it to see which systems are notified of shop events.
